about_the_game:
Within is a first-person game where you have to solve puzzles in grim locations. Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of mystery and danger as you unravel a crime and fight against a villain. But the further you progress, the more you realize that you yourself are becoming the victim...

YOU JUST NEED TO KEEP GOING

Don't give up. The only one you can rely on is yourself. In a world where every step brings you closer to the truth, but also to danger.

THE COST OF A MISTAKE IS TOO HIGH

In a game where every step is a struggle for survival, any mistake can be fatal. As you solve puzzles and fight for your life, you realize that the cost of a mistake is not just defeat, but life itself.

STAY ON THE PATH

You are the only one who can complete this journey. Don't give up, keep moving forward, because only you can reach the truth and escape the dangers that lurk around every corner.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 - 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Immerse yourself in the atmospheric world of a first-person thriller. You will face a cunning criminal. Explore locations, solve puzzles, and try to escape the nightmare. But be careful: you can become not only the hunter but also the prey.
supported_languages:
English*, Russian, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Polish, Ukrainian, Turkish, Finnish, Swedish
*languages with full audio support
